title: Daisy
body:
"Daisies are cheerful flowers with white petals and a bright yellow center."

Description

The Daisy are sellable common flowers, that can be found in the Finlay regions. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 75$ per daisy. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~2.11% per flower.
